tasks.title: Drawing Room: finalise layered lighting with track lights (no false ceiling)
tasks.detail: Owner 2026-10-04, decided: track lights plus the existing chandelier, no false ceiling, no table lamps and no swing-arm wall lights. The room has TWO ceiling fans (one at each end) and the chandelier midway between them. Drawn in the 3D model (Drawing Room, layout C): 48 V magnetic surface track, white, fixed straight to the slab. Track 1, 2.0 m, parallel to the TV wall and 400 mm in front of it: three 7 W spot heads (about 600 lumens each, 24-36 degree beam, anti-glare) aimed at the fluted panel, none at the screen. Track 2, 2.7 m, along the west wall 600 mm off it, over the sofas: two 15 W diffused linear heads (about 1,400 lumens each) between the two fans, and three 12 W READING heads (about 1,000 lumens each, 36 degree beam) pointing straight down at the seats: the two ends of the west sofa and the west end of the south sofa. Reading is done by turning Track 2 up; it is dimmed for TV. Totals: 4.7 m of track, 8 heads, 87 W, about 7,600 lumens, all dimmable. CIRCUITS (owner, later 2026-10-04): the heads on a track cannot be dimmed one by one, only the whole track, so ONE TRACK = ONE CIRCUIT, each with its own 48 V driver and its own wall dimmer: Track 1 on a 60 W driver (21 W of heads), Track 2 on a 100 W driver (66 W of heads), both hidden where they can be reached (the cap of the panel wall). Track 2 keeps its reading and diffused heads together on one dimmer: turn the whole track up to read, down for TV; the chandelier carries the general light. The mix of light on a track is fixed by which heads are clipped on. Colour: warm white 3000 K for the spots; the diffused and reading heads may be the tunable 3-in-1 type, neutral white being better for long reading. Mood light: dim the tracks, and use colour-changing (RGB + warm white) LED strip for the strip on top of the TV panel and the glow under the south sofa. Keep downward heads out from under the fan blades. The fan and chandelier positions in the model are assumed.
tasks.needs: MEASURE: the fan blade diameter and how far the fans hang (positions are from the phone scan). Buy track, heads and the two drivers from one maker so they fit each other; check the dimmer type matches the driver. The ceiling has a plaster moulding 330-400 mm in from the walls, where both tracks would be fixed (phone scan, C18): see the task on tracks and ceiling mouldings

Soft-close dampers; brush seals at the top and between panels and a brush strip along each bottom edge, to hold the AC cooling; recessed flush pulls. Each panel weighs roughly 55-60 kg, about 180 kg in all, hanging from the beam. PVC folding and crystal folding were considered and dropped. The 3D model still draws a 10-panel folding partition.

tasks.detail: Owner 2026-10-04: the window faces south-west and takes a lot of sun and heat in the Delhi summer; a curtain is used now. New information from the owner: the top of the window, about 1 ft, is a FIXED band, and the opening shutters start below it; there is a cover above the window. Design (drawing: docs/drawings/south-window-chick-cord.png): hang the screen close to the wall, about 85 mm out, from hooks just under the frame head. Rolled UP, the roll (about 100 mm across) parks in front of the fixed band, above the shutters, so all six shutters open freely under it. Rolled DOWN, it covers the whole window; the shutters must be shut first, which they are on a hot afternoon with the AC on. The pull cord comes INTO the room through a small lined hole (brass or ceramic eyelet) in the frame head and ties on a hook inside, so it is worked from inside. Hook the bottom rail to two hooks at the sill when it is down, so wind cannot swing it. PHONE SCAN 2026-10-04: the frame is 2,700 wide, the drop from the head to the sill about 1,500 and the top band about 390. Owner 2026-10-05: a ready-made outdoor HDPE roll-up blind is being considered instead of bamboo, tried first on one section (see the trial task); a 3 ft (914) piece suits one section, and three 4 ft pieces do not fit side by side. Stainless steel hooks. Plain bamboo lasts two or three monsoons outside; a PVC-coated or HDPE outdoor screen looks similar and lasts longer. This replaces the earlier idea of hanging it 450 mm out from the edge of the cover: no long brackets, less wind sway, better shade.
